Boiler enquiries in Glenrothes.

Whether you are planning maintenance or dealing with a fault in Glenrothes, explain what you need before arranging a boiler appointment.

BEFORE YOU ENQUIRE

Service, fault or replacement?

For routine servicing, share the appliance details and the date of the last service if you know it. For a fault, add the displayed code and whether heating, hot water or both are affected. For a replacement, explain what is prompting the change and how the household uses hot water.

  • Include the boiler make and model.
  • Say whether it is currently working.
  • Ask about availability and the scope of the visit.
